hook: Moses went forty days without bread or water.

verse.translation: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

story: Moses climbed Mount Sinai and stayed with God forty days and forty nights. He didn't eat or drink, and he came down with the ten commandments written on stone.

The church calls Moses the chief of the prophets, and names him first among the prophets who kept this fast. Ethiopian teachers say fasting was part of how he could enter the dark cloud where God was.
His forty days are where this fast gets its forty. The other days come later in the season, and we'll get to them.
meaning: Moses fasted forty days before he received God's word written on stone. We fast before Genna, when the Word of God Himself is born.

sources.title: Exodus 34:27–29 and John 1:14, World English Bible (public domain)
